RA16 / RA18: RockSmart Rocking Chair
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/norix-rocksmart-rocking-chair
Manufacturer page: https://norix.com/product/rocksmart-rocker/
Spec sheets: RA16 RockSmart 16”, RA18 RockSmart 18”, RockSmart Brochure
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Norix RockSmart Molded Rocking Chair – RA16 / RA18
Current H1: Norix RockSmart - Rocking Chair - One-Piece Rotationally Molded Polyethylene
Subtitle: One-Piece Ligature-Resistant Rocker in 16” and 18” Sizes, in Standard or Heavier Weight, with or without Runners
Current subtitle: Norix Furniture RA16, RA16-71, RA18, RA18-71, RA16-NR, RA16-NR-71, RA18-NR, RA18-NR-71
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Norix RockSmart Rocking Chair is a one-piece, rotationally molded rocker designed for therapeutic rocking in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. Its generous arc gives a relaxing, safe rocking action, and rear bumpers mark the limits of safe rocking. The ligature-resistant design has no internal openings, creases, or nooks where contraband can be hidden.
The chair is molded from high-impact polyethylene with UV stabilizers and Norix TruColor polymer for consistent, lasting color. It comes in 16” and 18” sizes, each in a standard or heavier weight model, with nylon runners to protect floors or without runners. The seamless surface can be cleaned with bleach solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants.
Construction: One-piece, rotationally molded high-impact polyethylene with ultraviolet light stabilizers to reduce fading
TruColor Polymer: Fully compounded color for consistent color and durability
Rocking Action: Generous arc for a relaxing and safe rock; rear nylon bumpers mark the limits of safe rocking
Runners: Securely affixed nylon runners protect floors (models without runners are also available)
Ligature Resistant: No internal openings
Chemical Resistance: Resists blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution, and chlorine solution
16” Rocker Size: 25.5”W×40.2”D×41.4”H, with a 17.5” seat height and 20.5” seat width
18” Rocker Size: 27”W×45”D×44”H, with an 18.5” seat height and 21.8” seat width
Weight: 49 lbs (16” standard), 51 lbs (18” standard), or 71 lbs (heavier weight models)
Colors: Twilight, Cove, Sage, Clay, Sand, or Dove
Static Load Testing: Tested to 1,000 lbs
Performance Standards: Dynamic drop tested to twice the ANSI/BIFMA X5.4 impact force (250 lbs from 18”)
Flammability Standards: California Technical Bulletins 133 and 117; UL 1056; ASTM E1537; UL 94 HB; NFPA 261
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
Cleaning: Simple Green or a similar cleaner for routine cleaning; bleach and water solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants such as Virex, Wexcide, or Oxivir Five 16 can be used per the manufacturer’s instructions
Safety Note: The rear bumpers deter backward tipping, but rocking aggressively may cause the chair to tip over; do not stand on the chair
Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty
Intended Use: Indoor use only
Country of Manufacture: USA
Available Models and Options
RA16 – 16” Standard: With runners, 49 lbs
RA16-71 – 16” Heavier Weight: With runners, 71 lbs
RA18 – 18” Standard: With runners, 51 lbs
RA18-71 – 18” Heavier Weight: With runners, 71 lbs
RA16-NR / RA16-NR-71 – 16” without Runners: Standard (49 lbs) or heavier weight (71 lbs)
RA18-NR / RA18-NR-71 – 18” without Runners: Standard (51 lbs) or heavier weight (71 lbs)
Extended Colors: Citrus, Malibu, Cobalt, Tranquil, Wisteria, LUX Ivory, and LUX Onyx, with a minimum order of 6 per color
Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The Norix RockSmart Rocking Chair suits rooms where residents benefit from calming, rhythmic movement, in spaces where a standard rocker would not be safe.
Typical applications include:
Dayrooms, activity rooms, and group rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Comfort rooms and calming rooms
Waiting areas and visitation rooms
Dayrooms and group rooms in correctional and detention facilities
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Norix Seating
Norix makes seating for behavioral healthcare, correctional, and other high-use facilities, from lightweight stackable chairs for staff areas to heavy, ballastable lounge seating for patient and inmate areas.
The Norix seating range includes:
Stackable Chairs: Integra, Progress, and Affinity
Guest and Lounge Seating: Flux, Forté, Vesta, Hondo Nuevo, Ripple, Wink, and Toro
Indoor and Outdoor Seating: Coupe, Flux, Pax, Kube, Goby, and Riptide
Upholstered Seating: Forma, Element, Harmony, and Respite
Rockers and Stools: Flux, Rocksmart, Mix-Up, and B-Side
Metal Seating: VersaFrame, Boulder, and Terra
[H2] About Norix Furniture
Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, police stations, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
Series section: same "About Norix Seating" section as the C920 tab.
Prices checked: all 8 variants are 80% of the Norix list price (RA16 / RA18 $1,161.60 of $1,452; -71 $1,453.60 of $1,817; -NR $995.20 of $1,244; -NR-71 $1,184.00 of $1,480). No change.
Weights checked: 49 / 51 / 71 lbs match the spec sheets, the price list, the live variants, and the worksheet (rows 187-194).
Static load: the Norix web page says "tested to 500 lbs," but the current RA16 and RA18 spec sheets say 1,000 lbs. I used the spec sheets.
INDOOR vs OUTDOOR: our page is tagged for outdoor spaces (bh-behavioral-health-furniture-outdoor-spaces, cd-furn-outdoor), but the Norix spec sheets say "Intended for indoor use only." I wrote it as indoor only. Should the outdoor tags be removed?
Image 7 is named "Norix_Oasis_Seat_Palette.png" and its alt text is "Norix Oasis Cafeteria Table," but the image shows the six RockSmart colors (Twilight, Cove, Clay, Sage, Sand, Dove), so it is the right chart with the wrong alt text. May I remove that alt text?
Extended colors: the price list and Norix web page list 7 extended colors with a 6-piece minimum per color. They are not variants on our page, so I listed them under Available Models. OK?
Left out: the patent number and the "bed bug resistant" claim from the Norix web page.
Images: the 7 current images are kept (6 colors and the color chart). Norix also has a dayroom photo with RockSmart rockers (2000×1335). Would you like me to add it as "Norix-RockSmart-Rocking-Chairs-Dayroom-View.jpg"?
Collections: the RockSmart is already in Behavioral Healthcare, Prison and Detention Furniture, and Norix Furniture.
Removed: the long old "About Norix Furniture" paragraph; replaced with the standard paragraph used on all Norix pages.
